ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.8:1 ratio of high-intensity (off-white/yellowish) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation is localized along the central vertical axis and peduncle, extending as a wide band toward the median notch. Secondary dark clusters are visible on the leading edge of the left lobe and along the proximal trailing edges. Large contiguous light-tan regions occupy the medial and distal sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying roughly 12% of the vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by recurring peaks and valleys with a pixel amplitude ranging from 5 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe edges follow a generally convex trajectory from the peduncle to the tips, with a slight concave transition observed immediately adjacent to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of raised, high-contrast circular pixels (barnacles) are present at both distal tips. A cluster of 4-6 distinct light-colored circular rosette scars (5-10 pixel diameter) is visible on the upper distal quadrant of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, unaligned dark linear disruption (~90 pixels in length) is visible on the lower medial quadrant of the left lobe, oriented diagonally toward the peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization on the distal extremities of both lobes; multiple healed circular lesions (rosettes) on the right fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellowish-tan pigmentation shift observed across the high-intensity regions, indicating a non-standard chromatic variance likely due to surface film.
